test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Spill the beans

options.text: To believe something as it seems
To do things in a fair way
To cry over what is done

solution:
The correct answer is: **To tell a secret**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"spill the beans"** means to reveal a secret or disclos
